verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers user-facing digital tools: the LathamDrive document generator and the Book of Jargon apps. These handle user data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence describes user-facing retention settings, deletion controls, or a data-retention policy. The Privacy & Cyber practice page describes legal advice to clients, not a product control, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
